body:
Reported Player(s):  Ender_Lord365
Rules Broken: B4
"Do not publicly accuse players are hacking."

Evidence: http://imgur.com/bMllIYe,lVls6gQ,eIgXNqT 

This player accuses others of hacking in chat.
When told to stop, he said that the player "needed to be shamed".

He didn't stop after being told to stop and taunted me after warning him that he will be reported if he continued. (Which he did)

This player has obtained an infraction for a chat-related offense in the past.
